$comment: Single source of truth for the playground: every app listed here exists in apps/<id>/ and is built and shown in the gallery.
`id` is immutable: it is the folder name under apps/, the URL segment, and the key used to derive the GitHub and CLI links.
Build output is assumed to be 'dist'; add "outDir" only when the toolchain differs (e.g. Next.js static export writes to 'out').
